patronOf.en-US: Abbot and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant us, through his teachings, the art of knowing how to speak with you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos aprender, por seu ensinamento, a arte de falar convosco.

meta.face: An Armenian monk of about fifty with a warm olive complexion and a BROAD, flat-planed OVAL face, as wide at the cheekbones as at the forehead, with a full, rounded jaw — a long, straight nose with a high, strong bridge, very large, wide-open dark almond eyes set level under thick, strongly arched black brows (the wide-eyed gaze of Armenian miniatures), smooth, full cheeks, a small, full mouth; short, thick black hair showing under the hood at the forehead; a short, dense black beard and moustache closely encircling the jaw, with a few grey threads; an intense, contemplative gaze lifted a little upward.
meta.basis: The miniature in the Matenadaran manuscript 1568 of 1173 shows him with short black hair, a short dark beard and very large eyes, holding a book; the card follows that face. The black pointed hood follows the dress of Armenian celibate priests and monks, and the background is his monastery by Lake Van.
